claims.quote: Genes like MUTYH, PNKP, UNG and XRCC1 showed a correlation with the immune infiltration levels and a significant correlation with various immune markers associated with different immune cells, including tumour-associated macrophages.
Our findings suggest that the BER genes MUTYH, PNKP, UNG and XRCC1 can potentially be prognostic biomarkers and highly correlate with the immune cells of the tumour microenvironment.
